title: Dont buy if you have glass stove top
text: Dont buy if you have glass stove top. Scratches stove top, brand new $600 stove with 1 inch scratch from this pan

product_metadata.title: T-fal Platinum Nonstick Jumbo Cooker 5 Quart Induction Cookware, Pots and Pans, Dishwasher Safe Slate
features: Longest lasting non-stick in the USA¹
Simulated to match up to 12 years of usage², this cookware lasts long enough to cook with the kids from preschool to college
10x more resistant vs. basic T-fal coatings
Thermo-Spot turns solid red to indicate when the pan is properly preheated (only on frypans and sauté pans)
Even-heat base prevents hotspots and is compatible with all cooktops including induction stovetops
Stainless steel riveted handles improve safety, maneuverability, and adds style
Dishwasher safe and oven-safe up to 500°F. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
¹ Based on abrasion and non-stick external testing done vs top 10 non-stick aluminum competitor pans <$29.99 (excluding hard anodized). 2020 Independent volume data.
² Based on 48,000 abrasion cycles. External Abrasion test based on internal protocols. Average consumer use 5 times per week
